candidates.label: Minimal n with S(n)=n(n+1)/2 >= |k| and (S(n)-|k|) even (classic sign-flip parity argument).
Uses strict s>ak instead of s>=ak, so whenever |k| is itself a triangular number the minimal n is missed by exactly one step (e.g. k=15=T(5) wrongly needs n=6, not 5).
Correct values but omits the required blank line between consecutive outputs.
